summary: In a divorce case heard in Anaconda, Dennis J. Murphy testifies that he married Ellen in Cork, Ireland on 1 March 1878, and that they have two sons, John and Michael, aged 12 and 9, both in his custody. Ellen left without cause or consent around 1 August 1889 and her whereabouts remain unknown. Murphy is granted a divorce.
key_quotes: without cause or provocation and without consent the defendant deserted her husband and has since remained absent
